description:
Are you a full stack web developer with back end focus in Python? We're seeking an agile, TS cleared developer familiar with Restful API's and modern DevOps practices to join us as an integral member of the IOMAXIS team in Quantico, VA where the work is truly dynamic, challenging and meaningful.



WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:



You will work with a small team of developers and researchers in an agile development environment. You must be comfortable with learning new technologies and be familiar with the software release process. You will work in a fast-paced mission-driven environment developing software packages deployed in support of cyber operations. This position shall be responsible for developing system design diagrams, as well as program design, coding, testing, debugging and documentation.
 Annual Salary: $210,000-230,000

 QUALIFICATIONS:
 Education: Bachelor's Degree in one of the following areas: Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or related field from an accredited university/college. We will consider experience in lieu of a degree.
 Clearance: Active Top Secret Clearance
 Skills / Capabilities:

- Full-stack Web Developer with back-end focus in Python.

- Familiar with Restful APIs and modern DEVOPS practices.

- Focus on web applications or databases is desirable.

- Experience in the direct performance of a major program, project, or activity relating to computer software development.
 Desired Experience:

- HTML5, JavaScript, Python, Django, Flask, Docker, Bottle, CSS

- Experience in setting up code to support CI/CD (continuous deployment/continuous integration)

- Flexibility to collaborate with other developers on projects

- Understanding of software engineering principles such as design, unit testing, continuous integration, and deployment

- Experience or interest in learning Cyber Security or previous CNO experience

- Experience with SQL and basic database functions and integration.

- Experience with mobile hardware, software and operating systems

- Experience working in a dynamic and fast paced environment #CJ
  

 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
 
 At MAXISIQ, inclusion drives innovation. We are committed to creating a diverse and equitable workplace where all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities.
